anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
No recent learning cycles or AI adjustments have been made, suggesting potential issues with AI model training or deployment.
Trading metrics show zero active trades and zero profit/loss, which may indicate a malfunction in trading operations or strategy execution.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review and potentially update AI models and strategies to ensure they are functioning and generating opportunities as expected.
Evaluate memory usage patterns to ensure efficient utilization and consider freeing up resources if necessary.

recommendations.action: Conduct a detailed analysis of CPU usage to identify and address any processes causing high load.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Perform a review of AI system logs and configurations to diagnose why no learning cycles or adjustments are occurring.
recommendations.rationale: Ensuring AI systems are learning and adapting is crucial for maintaining competitive trading strategies.

recommendations.action: Verify the operational status of trading strategies and systems to ensure trades are being executed as expected.
recommendations.rationale: Zero active trades and P/L may indicate a problem with strategy execution or system connectivity.
